Rule.name: HR CSV - Show Attributes On Identity Page
Rule.Description:
One-time setup rule. Adds the HR identity attributes (Status, Start Date, End Date, ...) to the "identityViewAttributes" list in UIConfig, which controls what the View Identity > Attributes tab shows. Existing entries are kept; attributes already in the list are skipped.
Run it from the IIQ console: rule "HR CSV - Show Attributes On Identity Page" Then log out and back in (or restart Tomcat) to see the change.
